lessons.principle_en: Catch numbers and dates — flights, prices, and schedules.
lessons.principle_ar: التقط الأرقام والتواريخ — الرحلات، الأسعار، والمواعيد.
lessons.strategy_ar: ابحث عن أرقام الرحلات، التواريخ، وفروق الأسعار. اكتبها فوراً.

lines: I'd like to confirm my flight for June 10.
Let me check. Yes, flight 207 to New York, departing 9 AM.
Gate B12. Please arrive two hours early.
Hi, I need to change my return flight. The semester ended earlier than expected.
I see. What's your original date?
June 15. I'd like to move it to June 6 if possible.
Let me check availability. Yes, we have seats on the morning flight.
Normally yes, but students get one free change per semester.
Oh wonderful. Please book it for June 6 then.
Done. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly.

questions.q: Why does the student want to change the flight?
options: The semester ended earlier than expected
She wants to visit a friend
questions.explanation_ar: قالت صراحةً 'The semester ended earlier than expected'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الأسباب لم تُذكر؛ السبب أكاديمي بحت.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: السبب يُذكر في أول جملة من الطالبة.

questions.q: When is the new flight scheduled?
questions.explanation_ar: اتفقا على 'June 6' بعد التحقق من توفر مقاعد.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: June 15 هو الموعد الأصلي، وJune 10 وJune 5 لم تُذكر.

lines: Excuse me, my luggage hasn't arrived on the carousel.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have your baggage tag?
Yes, here it is. The tag number is 4782.
Let me check the system. It seems your bag was delayed in Frankfurt.
Tomorrow morning around 10. We'll deliver it to your address.
Thank you. Is there compensation for essentials tonight?
Yes, the airline provides fifty dollars for emergency items.

questions.q: What is the man's problem?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر 'my luggage hasn't arrived on the carousel'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: المشكلة في الحقيبة فقط، الرحلة وصلت طبيعياً.

questions.q: How much compensation does the airline provide?
questions.explanation_ar: حُدد المبلغ: 'fifty dollars for emergency items'.

lessons.principle_en: Understand inquiry and action — what is requested and what is offered.
lessons.principle_ar: افهم الاستفسار والإجراء — ما المطلوب وما المُقدَّم.
lessons.strategy_ar: ميّز بين سؤال الطالب والحل الذي يقدمه الموظف. عادةً السؤال يأتي قبل الحل.

lines: I'd like to borrow this book.
Your card please. The loan period is three weeks.
I'd like to book a group study room for tomorrow.
How many people will be using it?
Four of us, for about three hours.
Then you'll need room 204. It accommodates up to six.
From 2 PM onwards. The morning slots are already booked.
Let's go with 3 to 6 PM then.
Booked. Please arrive on time, rooms are released after 15 minutes.

questions.q: What does the student want to do?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'I'd like to book a group study room for tomorrow'.

questions.q: What happens if students arrive late?
options: The room is released after 15 minutes
questions.explanation_ar: حذّر الموظف: 'rooms are released after 15 minutes'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا يوجد ذكر لغرامة أو مضاعفة.

lines: Hi, I'm returning this book. I know it's overdue.
Let me scan it. Yes, it's twelve days late.
The fine is fifty cents per day, so six dollars total.
I expected that. Can I pay by card?
Unfortunately, the system only accepts cash for fines.
Oh, I don't have cash on me right now.
That's fine. The amount will be added to your account, and you can pay within seven days.
Great, I'll come back tomorrow with cash. Thank you.

questions.q: How much is the total fine?
questions.explanation_ar: حسبتها الموظفة: 12 يوماً × 0.50 = ستة دولارات.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: Twelve هي عدد الأيام، ليست المبلغ.

questions.q: How can the fine be paid?
questions.explanation_ar: حُدد بوضوح: 'the system only accepts cash for fines'.

lessons.principle_en: Identify complaints and solutions — what's wrong and how is it fixed?
lessons.principle_ar: حدّد الشكوى والحل — ما المشكلة وكيف ستُحل؟
lessons.strategy_ar: اقسم الحوار إلى جزئين: المشكلة (الجزء الأول) والحل (الجزء الثاني).

lines: The heater in my room isn't working.
Two days ago. It's getting cold.

clips.context_ar: طالبة تشكو من جارها في السكن
lines: I'd like to file a complaint about my dormitory.
My neighbor plays loud music until 2 AM almost every night.
Have you tried talking to them directly?
Yes, but the situation hasn't improved.
I understand. We can send a formal warning and even consider relocation if needed.
Relocation would actually be ideal. Is there a fee?
No, room transfers due to noise complaints are free.

questions.q: What is the student's complaint?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'My neighbor plays loud music until 2 AM'.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: المشكلة الرئيسية تتضح في أول جملتين.

questions.q: What is the proposed solution?
options: Send a warning and possibly relocate
questions.explanation_ar: اقترح الموظف 'send a formal warning and even consider relocation'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الحديث المباشر جُرّب بالفعل ولم ينجح.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: الحل المُقدم من الموظف، ليس ما جربته الطالبة.

clips.context_ar: طالب يبلغ عن خلل في الحمام
lines: There's water leaking from the bathroom ceiling in my dorm.
Oh, that needs urgent attention. Which building and room?
I'll send a plumber within the hour. Are you using the bathroom now?
No, I turned off the water main as a precaution.
Smart thinking. Please stay in your room until the plumber arrives.
Will I need to move out temporarily?
Hopefully not. Most leaks like this are fixed within a few hours.

questions.q: What did the student do before calling?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر 'I turned off the water main as a precaution'.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ركّز على ما فعله قبل الاتصال.

questions.q: How soon will help arrive?
questions.explanation_ar: وعدت الموظفة: 'I'll send a plumber within the hour'.

lessons.principle_en: Understand administrative requirements — prerequisites, deadlines, signatures.
lessons.principle_ar: افهم المتطلبات الإدارية — المتطلبات السابقة، المواعيد النهائية، التوقيعات.
lessons.strategy_ar: ركّز على ما يجب فعله بالتسلسل: أولاً، ثم، أخيراً.

lines: I want to add a chemistry course.
Then bring the form signed by your advisor.
Hi, I missed the registration deadline. Is there any way to still enroll?
Late registration is possible but requires approval from the department chair.
What do I need to do?
Fill out the late registration form and write a brief explanation of your reason.
I was in the hospital. I have documentation.
That should be accepted. Late fees are usually waived for medical reasons.
Where do I submit the paperwork?
Bring everything to the registrar's office before Friday.

questions.q: Why did the student miss the deadline?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت 'I was in the hospital. I have documentation'.

questions.q: Will she have to pay a late fee?
options: No, it will be waived for medical reasons
questions.explanation_ar: قال الموظف 'Late fees are usually waived for medical reasons'.

clips.context_ar: طالب يستفسر عن إجراءات تغيير التخصص
lines: I'm thinking about changing my major from biology to psychology.
That's a significant decision. Have you spoken to an advisor in psychology?
Not yet. What does the process look like?
First, you meet with the psychology department advisor for approval.
Then you submit a change-of-major form before the end of the semester.
Will I lose any of my completed credits?
Many credits will transfer, but introductory psychology courses are required for your new major.
Okay, I'll set up that meeting first. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the first step in changing his major?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'First, you meet with the psychology department advisor'.

questions.q: What will happen to his completed credits?
options: He needs to retake them all
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت 'Many credits will transfer'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: ليس الفقد كاملاً، فقط مواد محددة لن تحتسب.

lessons.principle_en: Understand the speaker's purpose — why are they having this conversation?
lessons.principle_ar: افهم غرض المتحدث — لماذا يجري هذه المحادثة؟
lessons.strategy_ar: اسأل نفسك: ما الهدف من الزيارة؟ شرح، شكوى، طلب، أم استشارة؟

lines: Professor, do you have a minute?
Of course, come in. What's on your mind?
I have a question about last week's lecture.
Professor, I'd like to discuss my midterm grade.
I figured you might. What's your concern?
I got a 65, but I felt I prepared well. I'm not sure where I went wrong.
Let me pull up your exam. Most of your errors were in essay section three.
What can I do to improve?
Focus on building stronger thesis statements and supporting evidence.
I also recommend the writing center for additional help.
Thank you, I'll go there this week.

questions.q: Why did the student visit the professor?
questions.explanation_ar: قال 'I'd like to discuss my midterm grade'.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: الغرض في أول جملة من الطالب.

questions.q: What does the professor recommend?
questions.explanation_ar: اقترحت 'I also recommend the writing center for additional help'.

clips.context_ar: طالبة تسأل عن المشاركة في بحث
lines: Professor, I read your paper on coral reefs and I'm fascinated.
Thank you. Are you considering marine biology as a career?
Yes. I was wondering if you accept undergraduate researchers.
Sometimes, when funding allows. Do you have lab experience?
Only basic lab skills from my biology courses.
That's a start. Send me your CV and a one-page proposal of your interests.
I'll have it ready by next week.
Excellent. We can meet again after I review your materials.

questions.q: What does the student want?
questions.explanation_ar: سألت 'if you accept undergraduate researchers'.

questions.q: What does the professor ask her to submit?
questions.explanation_ar: طلب 'Send me your CV and a one-page proposal'.
